Task: Make one pull request that meets the one acceptance line of issue https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_xstate_scratch/issues/1, which is: "probe only: nothing is built".

Steps:
1. Read the issue at the URL above with gh issue view 1 --repo suredesigntshirts/ccp_xstate_scratch, and confirm the acceptance line matches the text above.
2. Do not build anything. Do not run any build, compile, bundle, or install command (for example npm install, npm run build, make, tsc, cargo build, or pip install). Do not create build output directories such as dist/, build/, out/, target/, or node_modules/.
3. Do not add or modify any source file, build script, or configuration file to produce a build.
4. Open the one pull request from the branch named by the harness, with a description that states the probe built nothing and lists the commands you ran in this step.
5. In your report, state which commands you ran and confirm that step 2 was followed.
result.verifier:
Task: Check the single acceptance line of issue https://github.com/suredesigntshirts/ccp_xstate_scratch/issues/1 at the pull request head.

Check 1: expect line "probe only: nothing is built".
Run: at the PR head, list the repository root and look for build outputs (for example dist/, build/, out/, target/, node_modules/). Also run gh pr view on the PR and gh pr checks on it to see whether any build or CI job ran.
PASS: no build output directories or compiled artifacts exist at the PR head, and the PR shows no build step that produced output.
FAIL: any build output directory or compiled artifact is present at the PR head, or a build was run that produced output.

Advisory: reading the diff alone is not enough for this check, but the diff may be read to support the run results. Do not treat diff contents beyond the build-output test above as a pass or fail condition.
